text: Healthy living is about more than just eating your vegetables. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs to function well. But food alone isn't enough. Regular exercise, even just a daily walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is sleep; aim for seven to eight hours each night so your body can repair itself. Don't forget your mental health, either. Taking time to relax, talk to friends, or practice mindfulness can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance. Set boundaries between your job and personal time, and make sure to schedule activities you enjoy. Small, consistent choices in these areas create a happier, more energetic you.
